name: Simple Bracket
description: Industry-style flow for a basic mounting bracket: envelope, features, optional standards, export.

steps.goal: Create the primary envelope solid for the bracket body.
steps.exit_criteria: At least one body exists representing the envelope.

steps.goal: Assemble solids (fuse), add cuts/holes/fillets, then export when finished.
steps.exit_criteria: One finished solid fused/cut as needed, exported or ready to export.

steps.goal: Optionally insert matching standard fasteners or profiles.
steps.exit_criteria: Standards inserted or step skipped when toggle is off.
